coder_result.remark: SOP and status rules are complete, correct, and aligned. All phases, approval gates, agent roles, and enforcement mechanisms are comprehensively covered. No revisions required.

findings.impact: Documents are ready for operational use

evidence.notes: SOP covers all 8 phases (Initiative, Planning, Task Graph, Task Execution, Implementation Planning, Review, Validation, Memory) and 9 agent roles (Planner, Task Decomposer, Implementation Planner, Executor, Reviewer, Validator, Memory Manager, Architect, Runner)
Status rules define 8 approval gates, 17 forbidden transitions, artifact lifecycle rules, authority model (CAN/CANNOT matrix), sidecar schema v2, and runner acceptance criteria

Project analysis confirms: advanced complexity, 9 recommended agent roles, all 7 delivery templates required, meta.json as ONLY communication channel, document-first execution, authority precedence (Runner > SOP > Status Rules > Metadata > Body)
